resources.string:
MindPulse uses this AccessibilityService to capture encrypted screenshots for an IRB-approved UW-Madison research study.

Because screenshots capture everything visible on screen, collected data may include: web browsing history; emails; SMS/MMS messages; other in-app messages; precise location; personal identifiers (name, email, phone, address); financial information; health data; photos; app usage; contacts; calendar events; search history; and other on-screen content.

Additional data collected separately: app usage metadata (active app name, timestamps); device diagnostic logs (for research quality assurance); location data (GPS coordinates collected alongside screenshots).

All data is encrypted on device and transmitted securely to authorized UW-Madison research systems. Participants can disable capture at any time.
